note: Candidates reviewed for this update but not admitted, with the reason and the evidence that would reopen each.

entries.candidate: Kuaishou Intelligent Cloud Ulanqab Data Center, stage 2 (快手智能云乌兰察布数据中心（二阶段）), Chahar High-Tech Zone, Ulanqab
entries.status_candidate: completed (stage 2 works delivered) or under_construction (completion acceptance in progress)
entries.reason: CSCEC's 24 October 2026 Ulanqab round-up (local cscec-ulanqab-1024.html) says China Construction Fifth Engineering Bureau's stage-2 works have been fully delivered (已全面交付) and completion acceptance is being pushed forward, so the physical stage is between completed works and pending acceptance and the scope of 'delivered' is not stated. No official locator was found: the Inner Mongolia Department of Ecology and Environment radiation-EIA lists (pages 0-40, back to about March 2025, plus the approval-result lists from September 2025) contain no Kuaishou substation item; the 2025 VNET Bayin EIA mentions Kuaishou only as an existing neighbour without a map label; the Ulanqab municipal hosts failed to connect.
entries.reopen_condition: An official coordinate or labelled official map for the Kuaishou Ulanqab campus (e.g. its substation EIA in the older provincial or Ulanqab EEB lists) plus a dated record that states the stage-2 completion or operation unambiguously.

entries.candidate: UCloud Ulanqab Intelligent Computing Center building D (优刻得乌兰察布智算中心D楼), Jining District, Ulanqab
entries.reason: CSCEC's 24 October 2026 item says CSCEC International completed 10 kV power energisation for building D and that the building is not yet complete. The UCloud Ulanqab campus is not in the Atlas and no official coordinate, planning board or EIA with coordinates was found in the reachable Inner Mongolia provincial lists; the Jining District and Ulanqab hosts failed to connect.
entries.reopen_condition: An official or operator-linked locator for UCloud's Ulanqab campus (or building D), then admit building D as under construction while the 24 October record is within the window (to about 17 January 2027).

entries.candidate: Huawei Cloud Ulanqab Phase 4 DC4 (乌兰察布华为云数据中心四期DC4), Chahar High-Tech Zone
entries.reason: Retained sixty-fourth hold. CSCEC's 24 October item reports current electrical, plumbing and HVAC works under the combined Phase 3 DC5 / Phase 4 DC4 contract. No Phase 4 property locator was found: the provincial radiation-EIA lists (to about March 2025) carry no Huawei Phase 4 item, and the Phase 3 map label cannot be reused for Phase 4.
entries.reopen_condition: An official map or coordinate identifying the Huawei Phase 4 property.

entries.candidate: Envision Ulanqab Zero-Carbon AI Computing Industrial Park Phase 3 (远景乌兰察布零碳人工智能算力产业园项目（三期）)
entries.reason: The same CSCEC item says CSCEC Harbour and Waterway Bureau's Phase 3 works are under way (winter construction toward main-structure milestones). Its location is known only from a secondary relay of the filing (west of Zanghong South Road, north of Pingzan Road), north of the road that bounds the Phase 1 park added in this fragment, so its relation to the Phase 1 site is unresolved, and no official coordinate was found. One project per new site per update also applies.
entries.reopen_condition: An official Phase 3 locator (EIA, planning board or land record) that shows whether Phase 3 lies on the Phase 1 park or a separate property; then add it as a project on the Envision site (reusing its locator) or as its own site.

entries.candidate: Envision 'Galaxy' base (远景星河基地) / Ulanqab Xinghe Technology Co., Ltd. data-centre project (乌兰察布星河科技有限公司星河乌兰察布数据中心项目), Jining District
entries.reason: The Inner Mongolia EED approved on 6 July 2026 (内环表〔2026〕131号; local nmg-xinghe-220kv-approval-0708.docx and the 39.6 MB report nmg-xinghe-220kv-eia-0708-long.doc) a grid company's bay expansion at the Shengjiaying 220 kV substation in Jining District to feed a new 'Xinghe 220 kV user substation' of the Xinghe Ulanqab data-centre project; the only coordinate printed is the grid substation's (113°17′46.220″E, 41°2′8.129″N), not the data centre's. Whether this 'Xinghe' (Galaxy) project is Envision's Galaxy base, and whether either is the Yiwutang Phase 1 park, is not established; the Phase 1 addition in this fragment does not assert either.
entries.reopen_condition: A record naming the Xinghe/Galaxy data-centre owner and its own site coordinate, plus an in-window dated status record.

entries.candidate: Zhongyun Zhisuan Jing-Meng Zero-Carbon Smart Computing Industrial Park (乌兰察布中云智算公司京蒙零碳智慧算力产业园), Chahar Right Front Banner
entries.reason: Only ancillary grid works were found: the Inner Mongolia EED approval of 1 July 2025 (内环表〔2025〕159号; local nmg-zhongyun-jingmeng-220kv-approval-0701.docx and the 87 MB report nmg-zhongyun-jingmeng-220kv-eia-0701-long.pdf) for two 220 kV lines from the Yifengyuan and Tianpishan substations to the park's own 'Jing-Meng 220 kV' user substation, whose outside cable terminal pole is at 40°48′12.764″N, 113°12′33.492″E. That is about 23 km from CIDC's Jing-Meng Green Computing Industrial Park added in this fragment, so it is a different park despite the similar name. No data-centre status record was found and the grid approval is outside the window.
entries.reopen_condition: An in-window dated primary record of the park's data-centre development or construction, plus an on-campus coordinate (the terminal pole is outside the user substation).

entries.candidate: Ulanqab Zhonglian Green Smart Computing Industrial Park (乌兰察布中联绿色智慧算力产业园) and VNET Ulanqab Cloud Intelligent Computing Center Base (乌兰察布世纪云公司云智算数据中心基地), Bayin area
entries.reason: Seen in the Inner Mongolia EED radiation-EIA lists (transitional 220 kV supply approvals of 7 August 2025 and 1 July 2025). Both are ancillary grid approvals outside the window with no in-window data-centre status record found; the VNET Bayin base belongs to the q3-china-operators beat, whose sixty-fourth packet excluded its conflicting coordinate.
entries.reopen_condition: An in-window primary data-centre status record and an on-campus coordinate for either park.

entries.candidate: China Broadnet (Ningxia Zhongwei) Data Center (中国广电（宁夏·中卫）数据中心), continuation project including the A4 data-centre building, Zhongwei West Cloud Base
entries.reason: New in-window record, but ancillary: on 23 October 2026 the Zhongwei Ecology and Environment Bureau accepted the EIA report form for the China Broadnet Ningxia 110 kV user-access cables (local zw-eeb-sl-1023.html and zw-cbn-110kv-eia-1023.pdf; builder State Grid Zhongwei Power Supply Company), which serve the new Broadnet substation and print cable-platform coordinates north of Fengyun Road beside the Broadnet data centre (about 105.330E, 37.635N). It states nothing about the data-centre buildings' status. The A4 building's planning permit dates from November 2025 and Phase 1 topped out in 2023, both outside the window. The thirty-fourth lead for Broadnet stands.
entries.reopen_condition: An in-window dated permit, construction, completion or operation record for the Broadnet data centre or its A4 building; the cable-platform or the 2025 110 kV substation EIA coordinates could then locate the campus after a check that they lie on it.

entries.candidate: China Unicom Ningxia Zhongwei Cloud Data Center: 2026 emergency water pool, two warehouses and diesel-generator platform (planning permit published 21 September 2026)
entries.reason: Support facilities on the existing China Unicom campus, not a data-centre building; a permit for them is not a permit for data-centre development and does not refresh DC9. The 3# substation permit of the same day is ancillary grid works.
entries.reopen_condition: None needed; record only if a later data-centre building permit or status for the campus appears.

entries.candidate: China Telecom Inner Mongolia 'D-zone computing centre project' (Horinger New Area item of 1 September 2026) and the B12 Ascend 950DT cluster
entries.reason: The information park's existing operations are added in this fragment. The 1 September 2026 construction-site item for a 'D-zone computing centre project' is still not tied to the park, and the 15 October B12 'landing' item does not state service; neither is asserted.
entries.reopen_condition: A source naming the D-zone project as part of the information park with a dated physical stage (then add it as a project reusing the park locator), or a dated statement that the B12 cluster is in service.

The cn-north reasons and reopen conditions stand.

entries.candidate: Gansu Qingyang data-centre cluster (Xifeng District) and Ulanqab municipal records (coverage limitation)
entries.reason: Re-probed 26 October 2026 with robots.txt only: www.zgqingyang.gov.cn, www.gsxf.gov.cn and fgw.zgqingyang.gov.cn answered HTTP 403 block pages; zrzyj, sthjj and ggzyjy.zgqingyang.gov.cn failed to connect; sthj.gansu.gov.cn served robots.txt (404) but its home page returned an HTTP 412 JavaScript challenge, which was not bypassed. www.wulanchabu.gov.cn, sthjj.wulanchabu.gov.cn and zrzyj.wulanchabu.gov.cn failed to connect. No Qingyang candidate (Chindata Qingyang 1, VNET Qingyang, others) could be located.
entries.reopen_condition: A reachable official Qingyang/Gansu or Ulanqab source (or a stated Internet Archive copy) with dated permits or EIA records and coordinates.
